governed_by: content/series1/episodes/s1a01/script.hi.json and script.en.json (same beats b1, b2, b3, b5 to b11, lines l01 to l28, speakers; b4 is a gap)
content/series1/episodes/s1a01/voice/manifest.jsonl and voice/review.json (final takes: hi l04, l16, l20, l24 take 2; en l16 take 2; every line final, hi l24 accept_logged)
content/series1/style.json (locks rewritten after Gate 3, style_frame, light_states, key_props, prompt_assembly)

runner: production/scripts/codex-frame.sh <frames_dir> <shot_id> <frames/prompts/<shot_id>.txt> [refs in the order listed in the shot]. Only shots with frame.kind = generated go to the runner, in generation_order.

frame_budget.note: 28 new frames for 39 shots. Second framings reuse a generated frame of this episode with a custom move at scale 1.3 or less (D-010). No second framing takes a close from a wide (D-023 rule 4.8): the b3 closes come from generated close-ups (s05, s06), the l17 close and l19 insert from the medium close-up s22, the l26 single from the medium single s32. s02 is the approved s1e01 frame s12 (the same phone on the same sheet), not a new frame. Retakes (D-023 rule 4.1) are retakes, not budget.

estimated_seconds.basis: Final-take clip lengths measured with ffprobe on voice/hi/lXX.mp3 and voice/en/lXX.mp3 (these files hold the final takes; they equal manifest duration_s of the latest take), plus 0.25 s after each line (s1e01's convention; none after l09, which l10 cuts straight in on), plus the script's beat silences (b1 1.2, b2 2.0, b3 1.2, b5 3.0, b6 1.0, b7 2.0, b8 4.5, b9 4.5, b10 0, b11 3.0 = 22.4 s). Speech (whole clips, including their own lead and trail silence): hi 90.80 s, en 89.76 s. duration_s per shot is the longer language; each cut is rebuilt from its own clips (D-014 rule 6). hi l24 (take 2, accept_logged) carries 1.56 s of lead silence and 0.94 s of trail: the Hindi s34 can lose up to about 1.5 s in the edit (D-014 rule 2: the cue starts at first speech).
estimated_seconds.clarity_remap_D025: 2026-11-26, S7 Storyboard artist, clarity remap (D-025 item 8): totals re-summed from the shots after the remap. Shots that gained lines or changed split are timed from the clarity takes (voice/manifest.jsonl, highest ok take per line): whole clip length + 0.25 s after each line, plus the beat silence the shot carries; split parts at the midpoint of the measured pause (silencedetect -40 dB, 0.15 s). Other voiced shots are shifted by (clarity take - previous take) for each re-voiced line. Planned only: the build times voiced shots from speech.

longest_setup.rule: No set-up held past 8 s (bible production_locks; D-018 on measured lengths). Every shot is under 8 s in both languages, and so is every run of consecutive shots on one frame: s16+s17 6.66 s (en), s34+s35 5.06 s (hi), s38+s39 6.53 s (en).

scenes.kiran_period: period 1 (red saree) b1 and b3; period 2 (grey) b5

First frame of the scene with the lead's face: Kiran and Aditya on the stairs, the bulb, the flight. s13 is a pull on it; s14 and s16 attach it.

First frame of the scene that shows the lead (s18 is a wide with no readable face, s19 the mirror, s20 Aditya): Kiran in profile in the front seat, the dashboard, the dawn window. b8's frames attach it and list its blue light under do-not-copy (car_first_sun).
b9 is outside the car at the bureau's shutter, a new setting and light; the car anchor shows none of it. s28 is the first frame with the lead's face there.
scenes.light_state: bureau_arrival (s30 also shows the bureau_morning room through the risen shutter)

scenes.anchor_reason: First frame inside the bureau and the first with the lead's face there: Mausi holding Kiran's face.

generation_gates: D-015 rule 7 and D-013 rule 2: generate the six anchors (s03, s04, s15, s21, s28, s31), run the anchor check, then the other 22. Every later frame attaches its anchor's png, so none can run before its anchor is approved. s04 is the lane's only frame.

D-023 rule 4.1: the frame check, one retake for each rejected frame plus the first attempt of any frame waiting on a rejected anchor, the retake check, and only then the edit. Second framings inherit their source frame's verdict; s02 inherits s1e01 s12's 'approved'.

D-021 decision 6 (retake check of the regenerated sheets) was to finish before the first anchor that attaches a sheet it names. I found no report of it (S9 found none for s1e01 either, D-023 not verified). Frames here attaching named sheets: mausi (s30, s32, s38), pair_kiran_mausi_p2 (s31, s37), the Kiran pairs pair_kiran_aditya_p1 (s03) and pair_kiran_aditya_p2 (s15, s24, s28, s34), lane_night (s04, s14). style.json locks_source records S6's full-resolution crops of Mausi's face, hand and keys, which covers part of that check. Whether to hold these frames is the orchestrator's call; I have not held them.

D-021 style-frame watch: s21 (car dawn), s28 (shutter, low sun) and s31 (bureau day) attach the night style frame bedroom_bed. The anchor check should say whether they copy its garlands, grille or lamp, or inherit its night light; if so, D-021's fallback (bureau_front as the day style frame) applies before the other day frames run.

D-017 height watch: s34 is the first same-depth Kiran-Aditya two-shot in this episode with the line-up sheet attached (s15 and s28 put him a step up or at a different depth). If his height is wrong there, D-017's restage applies to its retake (never side by side at the same depth).

D-023 rule 4.6 (Series 1 right-cuff rule) does not bite in s1a01: s1e02 b1 brought the right cuff down (P02), so both cuffs are at rest in every shot. kiran_hands is attached only to shots whose cuff state is 'at rest' (s10, s26, s29, s38), and every one of those prompts lists its view 3 (cuff pushed up, scar bare) under do-not-copy; view 2 (back of the hand, cuff at rest) is the matching view.

Glimpse A (s1ga, bible glimpses.A) may cut from s01, s12, s18 to s21, s28 and must end on s29 before the shutter rattle. It must not use s30 (Mausi's face, the shutter open), s27 (Billu has seen the print) or anything from b10 and b11.
screen_direction: Bedroom b1 and b3 (geography from style.json: facing the headboard, window in the right wall, almirah and chair on the left wall, door behind): Kiran sits on the window-side edge of the bed by the stool; Aditya stands by the chair at the almirah wall. The line runs between them across the bed. Every camera stays on the door side of it. The two-shot s03 (bedroom_bed, from the door) has Aditya on picture-left facing right and Kiran on picture-right facing left. Kiran's singles (s01, s05; bedroom_window) have her look just past the picture-left edge of the lens; Aditya's single (s06; bedroom_bed turned to the almirah wall) has him look just past the picture-right edge.

Bedroom b5: Kiran at the open almirah (s10, picture-left of the room, she looks towards picture-right); Aditya at the foot of the bed on the window side (s11, bedroom_window from beside the almirah, he looks just past the picture-left edge). s12 is at the door.

Stairwell b6: s15 and s13 look up the flight from the street door (handrail on the picture-right wall); s14 is the reverse, down the flight to Billu in the open street door; s16 and s17 are Aditya's hands seen from Billu's position.

Car b7 and b8 (right-hand drive; Billu front right, Kiran front left, Aditya rear left behind Kiran): s21, s22, s23, s25 and s26 look across from the driver's side, so Kiran is in right profile facing picture-right (hoop hidden). s19, s24 and s27 look forward from the rear bench (driver picture-right). s20 looks back from between the front seats (Aditya picture-right, as car_rear).

Shutter b9: the car stands at the kerb, its left side to the shop fronts, nose away from the camera. s28 looks forward along its left side from behind the left rear corner, so the joined hands (her LEFT, his RIGHT) are on the near side; shops on picture-left; low sun from behind the camera. s29 is the same side, macro, her hand towards picture-left. s30 is the reverse, low from the car door towards the risen shutter.

Bureau b10 and b11: s31 and s37 face into the room (bureau_front direction) with Kiran picture-left facing right and Mausi picture-right facing left, so Mausi's left side (her one stud, her keys) is towards the camera and her right profile is never shown (D-021 decision 4). s32 faces her at the desk. s33 and s34 face the shutter (bureau_reverse): the cot on picture-left, the mirror wall kept out of frame (D-007 direction 16). s38 is an insert at the desk with Aditya beyond the hands.

state_ledger.source: continuity.json has no beat-level ledger for s1a01. Built from continuity.json (s1e02 end_state, s1a01 end_state, wardrobe_changes, P01 and P08 as now written in the script), style.json characters and key_props, and the script's action lines. Sides are the character's own; every prompt converts them to picture terms (D-013 rule 3).
constant: Kiran: chooda complete and at rest on both forearms in every shot (left cuff complete since s1e02 b4; right cuff brought down in s1e02 b1, P02). The scar is never in frame (writer_notes: no frame shows the scar).

Aditya: glasses and the brass key on its doubled red thread in every shot; watch on his LEFT wrist; patch pocket on his RIGHT chest (style.json lock over the script's 'right kurta pocket'). Barefoot in the bedroom (b1 to b5), tan sandals from b6.
Billu: toothpick in the RIGHT corner of his mouth throughout; key on his RIGHT index finger in b2 and b6, in the ignition from b7 to b9; no weapon.
Mausi (from b9): keys at her LEFT hip, green glass bangles on both wrists, thin gold band on her RIGHT hand, one stud in her LEFT nostril; never a close right profile.
Chhoti (b10): henna on her LEFT palm and fingertips only; pink phone in her RIGHT hand; two green bangles on her RIGHT wrist; left wrist bare.

Her phone face up on the sheet between them, on speaker. Aditya across the room by the chair, the steel dabba in his hand (P01). Tray on the stool: tumbler full and untouched, fold open, half full. Padlock locked. Print on the sheet, not shown. Maroon bag on the chair, side pocket open and empty.

Aditya, barefoot, with the closed red velvet box in his LEFT hand. Then: the fold folded shut and the print both in his RIGHT chest pocket (P08); his key, still on its thread, turned in the padlock, shackle open, hasp still closed, bolt still shot.

field_notes.duration_s: Longer language, this shot (max of duration_hi_s and duration_en_s). silent_s is the part of the shot that is a script beat silence; silent-only shots have no line_ids and run duration_s (build_timeline silent_frames).
field_notes.silent_lead_s: 0 on every line shot: no beat silence sits before a line inside a line shot; each 'before' silence is its own shot (s04, s13, s18, s26, s27).
field_notes.camera_move: Move in production/remotion/src/types.ts. For 'custom', from/to are CameraKey {scale, x, y}: x positive looks further left, y positive looks further up (camera.ts), clamped to -1..1. Every custom key is at scale 1.3 or less.
field_notes.refs: Absolute paths, at most five, in the order the prompt labels them: people (pair or single sheet, hand sheet), plate, prop sheets, then the scene anchor or, on an anchor, the style frame last (D-013 rule 1, D-017 amendment 3, D-021 decision 3).
field_notes.frame.prompt_sha: sha256 of the prompt file, first 12 characters, the same measure the runner writes to the manifest.
field_notes.subtitle_safe: true = faces, hands that matter and the key object are above the bottom fifth of the frame (as prompted; not yet checked on a picture).

storyboard_notes: 39 shots for 10 beats, 28 generated frames (D-010), 10 second framings, 1 reused approved frame. Every script set-up is covered; where two set-ups share one frame it is listed below.

Departures to stay inside 28 frames, each logged so the one-frame fix is clear if it reads wrong in the cut: (1) s02 (b1 shot 2) is the approved s1e01 s12 phone insert. (2) b3's four set-ups and its silence use two generated close-ups: s07 and s09 push in on s05, s08 on s06. (3) b5's two silent inserts are one set-up, s12, with a pan from the pocket (fold and print already in it) to the key in the padlock; the folding of the paper over the tray is not shown. (4) s13 (b6 silent before) is a pull on the s15 two-shot, not a view from behind Billu's head. (5) s17 (l12, Billu's laugh) plays over a closer framing of the brass set, not on Billu. (6) s25 (l19) is a push on s22 and keeps its blue light; the warm turn lands on the cut to s26. (7) l24 and l25 share the s34 two-shot; the script's Aditya close for l24 is not made. (8) l28's insert and b11's held set-up share s38; the focus pull is a camera move from the hands up to his eyes.

Departures forced by the stills or the geography: (1) s19: the toothpick is not in frame (the camera is behind Billu and the toothpick is on the far corner of his mouth). (2) s20: Billu's eyes in the mirror are dropped; a camera facing the rear bench cannot see the mirror glass. (3) s24 and s27: the mirror shows only a blur in s24 (to keep two faces at most) and Billu's eyes in s27.
Light: the script calls the lane and the stairwell door's light sodium; style.json makes the lane's streetlight cool blue-white (art_director_notes), and the prompts follow style.json, as s1e01 did.

Locks over script wording: Aditya's pocket is the patch pocket on his RIGHT chest (style.json); Kiran's grey sleeves end just below the elbow (style.json), so b5's 'a hand's width of bare forearm above the cuff' is kept and the script's 'three-quarter sleeves' is not; Mausi's lips are muted rose-red (lock), her 'paan smile' is played as a warm closed smile.

Readable text is overlay only: 'मौसी' / 'Mausi' and '2:00' on the phone screen in s02; '3:00' on the plain dark wall area s15 leaves at upper picture-left, used in s13; 'मौसी' / 'Mausi' on the phone screen at the lower picture-left edge of s23. The bureau signboard is blank.

Faces per frame: never more than two sheet faces (D-021 decision 8). Two-face frames: s03, s15 (and s13), s24 (Aditya only as a soft glasses edge), s28, s31, s34 (and s35), s37. Billu's boys are backs only (s04). Mausi is never in a close right profile.

The scar is in no frame. Every shot that attaches kiran_hands (s10, s26, s29, s38) states the cuff at rest, frames out any forearm skin near the scar's place, and lists the sheet's scar view under do-not-copy.
Mohit, the photograph's picture side and the boys' faces are in no frame. The print appears only as its white back (s12, s20, s27).
